referents.why: The verb 'he said' is third masculine singular, a wayyiqtol continuing 'the LORD answered Job'. The speaker of the whole speech is the LORD (w2), the only masculine singular proper subject who acts here.

links.why: Wayyiqtol with a separate waw: answered, and then said. The narrative line continues.

cant_tell.what: Whether the speech's parts from 38:2 to 38:38 form one turn or several nested turns
cant_tell.why: Only 38:1 is judged here; the parts are linked when those verses are judged.

cant_tell.what: The speech introduced by 'and said' (cl1) has its content from 38:2 onward. Its content link and turn are recorded at 38:2, where the first said clause is judged.
cant_tell.why: A link from this saying clause cannot be written forward into a later verse from here, so it is recorded once, at the first said clause.
